macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: Global stocks mixed as earnings season begins
items.summary: Asian shares traded unevenly on Monday, while S&P 500 and Nasdaq futures edged higher as investors prepared for major-bank earnings and fresh U.S. inflation data. Oil prices slipped amid uncertainty over potential Russian energy exports.[4]

items.title: Bank earnings and inflation data set to drive markets
items.summary: Investors are focused on results from JPMorgan Chase, Goldman Sachs, Bank of America, Citigroup, Morgan Stanley and Wells Fargo, alongside September CPI and PPI reports. Analysts expect strong third-quarter earnings growth, concentrated in technology.[1][2]

items.title: Markets scale back near-term Fed rate-hike expectations
items.summary: Interest-rate markets imply an approximately 18% probability of a Federal Reserve hike at the October meeting, while pricing reflects an approximately 85% probability of a December increase. Investors are also considering possible rate increases by the European Central Bank, Bank of Japan and Bank of England.[4]

items.title: Inflation, yields and oil remain key risks
items.summary: Rising energy costs are expected to push September U.S. headline CPI higher, while elevated government-bond yields continue to pressure equity valuations. The dollar remained near a 17-month high, and the yen stayed close to levels that have raised intervention concerns in Japan.[4][5]

items.title: TSMC and chip earnings in focus
items.summary: TSMC is expected to report a sixth consecutive quarter of record earnings, making semiconductor results an important test of continued artificial-intelligence investment and technology-sector profit expectations.[4]

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin Breaks Above $84,000
items.summary: Bitcoin rose 1.17% over 24 hours and moved above $84,000, according to a crypto-market news roundup.

items.title: Ethereum Foundation Transfers 4,393 ETH to Kraken
items.summary: The Ethereum Foundation moved 4,393 ETH to Kraken, prompting speculation about potential market-selling implications.

items.title: ESMA Sets Deadline for Non-Compliant Stablecoin Services
items.summary: The European Securities and Markets Authority reportedly directed EU crypto-asset service providers to stop offering services involving stablecoins that do not comply with MiCA and resolve existing exposure by January 8, 2027.

items.title: Cardano CIP-0113 Goes Live on Mainnet
items.summary: Cardano’s CIP-0113 tokenization standard has launched on mainnet and received recognition from the Capital Markets and Technology Association, though wallet integration and issuer adoption remain developing.

items.title: Starknet Considers Transition to Independent Layer 1
items.summary: Starknet is reportedly evaluating a shift to an independent Layer 1 network and targeting a fully quantum-resistant network by 2027; STRK gained about 20% over 24 hours in the cited report.

items.title: Kyrgyzstan Shuts Down USDKG
items.summary: Kyrgyzstan reportedly shut down the USDKG stablecoin amid wider regional regulatory tightening of crypto markets.

ai_news.query: What are the most important artificial intelligence and machine learning news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include new model releases, company announcements, research breakthroughs, and industry trends.

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: Ace Combat 8 sales surpass 1 million
items.summary: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve has sold more than one million copies within a week of release, reportedly making it the fastest-selling entry in the series’ 30-year history.

items.title: Machinarium 2 announced
items.summary: Amanita Design announced Machinarium 2 during the Triple-i Initiative presentation, marking the return of the acclaimed puzzle-adventure series.

items.title: Forza Horizon 6 confirmed for PlayStation 5
items.summary: Xbox Game Studios and Playground Games announced that Forza Horizon 6 will launch on PlayStation 5 in January 2027 alongside its first expansion and a free update.

items.title: Ninja Gaiden 4 released
items.summary: Microsoft and Koei Tecmo released Ninja Gaiden 4 for PC, Xbox Series X|S, and PlayStation 5; it is also available through Game Pass.

items.title: Jurassic World Evolution 3 launches
items.summary: Jurassic World Evolution 3 is now available on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC through Steam and the Epic Games Store.

items.title: South Korean game-industry outlook weakens
items.summary: South Korea’s game-industry business outlook for the fourth quarter fell to 99.2 from 100.0 in the previous quarter, with widening performance gaps between major and smaller companies contributing to pessimism.
